dispositionPolicy.meaning: `disposition` is the conservative aggregation of explicit bounded site-content classifications for this source-unit join; `reviewState` and `siteContentComplete` are separate. A group with mixed content/missing facets is partial. `citation-only` is retained only where a source reference exists without represented source content. `excluded` is product-scope, not a source semantic pass. `unassessable` is reserved for actual source/evidence limitations; unfinished operational review is pending.
dispositionPolicy.workflowRule: Never infer site-content completeness from reviewClosed. New supplemental source units remain child subscopes and do not inflate the 559 original-unit denominator. Historical or predecessor-hash reports remain traceable but do not silently supersede exact newer report revisions.

spellSourceChildAssessments.assessmentScope: PHB rebellion check versus MM lost-concentration resolution
spellSourceChildAssessments.sourceFindingSummary: PHB p.79 represents the 5% rebellion check at the end of the second and each succeeding round, regardless of concentration. MM p.37 separately resolves a failure to concentrate: 75% turns on the summoning party and attacks; 25% does not turn and immediately returns to its plane. PHB 5% and MM 75/25 have different triggers, so there is no printed contradiction or precedence ruling to invent.
